purpose: Teach: 西海岸/ルパン/カンヌ/トロント/スリランカ/レバノン/マニラ/江戸川

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アメリカ西海岸に留学したいって言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, didn't you say you wanted to study abroad on the West Coast?
lines.style: Casual, direct accusation with a hint of teasing. Leans back slightly, eyes narrowed with curiosity. Testing what he'll say next.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ルパン三世のアニメ全話観たろ?桜
lines.en: You watched all of Lupin the Third, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick counter-volley, matter-of-fact. Not defensive, just turning the mirror back. Steady eye contact, almost amused at the game.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、カンヌ映画祭の作品観に行ったな
lines.en: Riku, you went to see films at the Cannes Film Festival, didn't you?
lines.style: Pressing forward, undeterred. Rhythmic rhythm to the accusation. Eyes bright with the pleasure of knowing his secrets. Slight uptick at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でトロント旅行行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You took a family trip to Toronto, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her tempo. Each fact lands with quiet precision. Slight smile at the corner of his mouth — he's been keeping score too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、スリランカ紅茶ハマってたな
lines.en: Riku, you got really into Sri Lankan tea, didn't you?
lines.style: Dropping it almost casually, like she's barely trying. But her timing is sharp. Eyes glinting. She's enjoying this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でレバノン情勢勉強したな、桜
lines.en: You studied the Lebanon situation in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Slight vocal relax on his name — familiarity showing through. This isn't confrontation, it's communion. They're matching each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、マニラに修学旅行行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you went on a school trip to Manila, didn't you?
lines.style: Energy rising slightly. She knows she's near the end of her list. Voice quickens. A slight breathlessness — the pleasure of having done the homework.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、江戸川区の花火大会行ったな、桜
lines.en: You went to the Edogawa fireworks festival, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft landing. Slower pace than the volleys before it. Voice drops slightly. Intimate and close. The final card, played gently.
